proposals.root_cause: Quality review needs a stronger boundary between final copy and process explanation.

proposals.expected_improvement: Improve naturalness score without adding fixed replacement phrases.
proposals.risk: Over-penalizing explanatory drafts may reduce useful scaffolding in early ideation sessions.
proposals.validation_plan: Run naturalness-sensitive eval cases and compare naturalness_delta before applying.
proposals.predicted_metric: naturalness_score improves while expected signal coverage remains stable
